question: In what form and into whom does the speaker claim to enter?
premises: The speaker declares an act of entering.
The entry is directed into the addressed recipients.
The entry takes place in a complete form.
inference: The speaker enters fully into the addressed recipients in complete form.
uncertainties: The scope of the vocative address relative to the plural recipients is not fully explicit.
plain_english: I enter into you, O Śaṅkara, in my complete form.
